text:
maria: @here Customer reports structured JSON responses started failing parsing after our canary swap to llama4b-v2.1 this morning. They get a JSON parsing error from their webhook consumers.

maria: quick repro and payload they sent: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \u00b4-H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \u00b4-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \u00b4-d '{\"model\":\"llama4b-v2.1\",\"mode\":\"json\",\"prompt\":\"return {\\\"order_id\\\":123, \\\"items\\\":[{\\\"id\\\":\\\"sku-1\\\",\\\"qty\\\":2},{\\\"id\\\":\\\"sku-2\\\",\\\"qty\\\":1}] }\"}'
```

maria: response they see (trimmed):
```json
{
  "choices": [
    {
      "text": "{\"order_id\":123, \"items\":[{\"id\":\"sku-1\",\"qty\":2},{\"id\":\"sku-2\",\"qty\":1], }"
    }
  ]
}
```

maria: notice the trailing comma inside the generated JSON object before the closing brace — their parser errors on that. Customer says this only started after the canary roll.

devon: can you paste the request_id / llm_request_id? need logs. also which canary cluster (canary-east-1?)

maria: request_id=rid_0a9c4e, canary=canary-east. I pulled the runtime logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:05Z] [rid_0a9c4e] model llama4b-v2.1 generated chunk 0: "{\"order_id\":123, \"items\":["
[2026-03-15T10:12:05Z] [rid_0a9c4e] model llama4b-v2.1 generated chunk 1: "{\"id\":\"sku-1\",\"qty\":2},{\"id\":\"sku-2\",\"qty\":1}], }"
```

maria: looks like chunking produced an extra "," before final brace (maybe new stop token or formatting change).

sam: ML eng here. We shipped a small formatting prompt tweak in v2.1 to encourage trailing comma for lists in some locales (to aid downstream diffing). That SHOULD NOT affect strict json mode; seems the string template logic that strips trailing delimiters didn't run for some chunk boundaries.

sam: likely root cause: when the model emits final chunk that contains both the last array element and the closing brace, our postprocessor that trims trailing commas only runs on whole-response sanitized path. With streaming chunk boundary we missed it.

maria: customer impacted: high-volume ecommerce integration, failing order ingestion for ~7% of requests since 09:58 UTC. They flagged P1.

devon: recommended mitigation: 1) Add a short-term server-side sanitize step for json-mode outputs to remove ", }" -> " }" and ", ]" -> "]" before returning to user. 2) Pause canary rollout and fallback traffic to llama4b-v2.0 for canary-east. 3) Add unit test for chunked-trailing-comma.

sam: I can push a hotfix to the postprocessor (simple regex) and run regression evals. If it's quick, do hotfix then throttled canary. If not, rollback.

maria: ops, can we do a rollback now? infra-bot shows canary-east has 12% traffic.

infra-bot: Rollout status: canary-east: 12% -> v2.1 (started 2026-03-15T09:50Z). Fallback candidate: llama4b-v2.0.

devon: I'll coordinate rollback windows. If sam's patch is >30m, rollback. If patch <20m and tested, patch.

sam: patch prepared, running quick unit tests now. Patch: after assembling chunks run sanitizers: 
```python
# postprocessor snippet
def sanitize_json_mode(s):
    s = re.sub(r",\s*([\]}])", r"\1", s)
    return s
```

# quick local tests: passing 94/96 tricky prompts (failing cases are rare string edgecases we need to handle)

maria: customer agreed to temporary fallback if we need it. They prefer hotfix so they don't lose perf.

sam: deploying hotfix to canary-east now, will report within 10m.

maria: noted. I'll update customer and set expectations.

sam: hotfix deployed to canary-east at 2026-03-15T10:24Z. Running smoke.

maria: customer testing — they reported success on first 50 requests. parser errors dropped to 0/50.

devon: keep an eye on telemetry for 1 hour, then promote global if stable. I'll open a follow-up ticket to add explicit chunk-boundary sanitizer in runtime.

maria: closing loop with the customer and marking as resolved if no regression in 1h. Thanks all. :tada:
